<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
  ============================================================
  DONATION_URL — REPLACE BEFORE GOING LIVE
  The original site has no online donation link, so every Donate
  button uses the placeholder in the <script> at the bottom.
  Replace it with your real Stripe Payment Link / JustGiving / PayPal page.
  Search this file for: DONATION_URL
  All photos are embedded (base64) from communitywishesleicester.godaddysites.com
  ============================================================
-->
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Community Wishes (Leicester) | Granting wishes, changing lives</title>
<meta name="description" content="Community Wishes (Leicester) grants wishes to people suffering financial hardship, illness or disability, regardless of youth or age. Registered charity 1196244.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:title" content="Community Wishes (Leicester)">
<meta property="og:description" content="Our mission is to grant wishes to people who are suffering financial hardship, illness or disability regardless of youth or age. Registered charity 1196244.">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://img1.wsimg.com/isteam/ip/4e9549ed-511d-4e6c-a30c-677b5d57eadd/367485604_6834383706646253_7721024406754819091.jpg/:/rs=w:1200,h:630,cg:true,m/cr=w:1200,h:630">
<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200"><meta property="og:image:height" content="630">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0a1226">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@700;900&family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,500;0,9..144,700;1,9..144,600&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--ink:#0d1628;--ink2:#46536a;--bg:#fbf8f3;--navy:#0a1226;--brand:#c0264f;--gold:#f5c451;--gold2:#ffe9a8;--line:#ebe3d6;--r:24px;--sh:0 30px 60px -25px rgba(10,18,38,.35)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg);line-height:1.65;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}a{color:inherit}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:auto;padding:0 24px}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px}.skip:focus{left:12px;top:12px;background:#fff;padding:8px 14px;z-index:999;border-radius:8px}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:8px}
.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--brand);margin-bottom:16px}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:28px;height:2px;background:currentColor}
section{padding:120px 0;position:relative}
h2.t{font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4.4vw,3.4rem);margin-bottom:22px}
.lead{font-size:1.18rem;color:var(--ink2);margin-bottom:16px}
/* buttons */
.btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:16px 30px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .3s,box-shadow .3s,background .3s;border:1.5px solid transparent;overflow:hidden;font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer}
.btn-p{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#c0264f,#e0446e,#c0264f);background-size:200%;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(192,38,79,.8);animation:gr 6s linear infinite}
.btn-p:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 20px 40px -12px rgba(192,38,79,.9)}
.btn::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.45) 50%,transparent 70%);transform:translateX(-120%);transition:transform .7s}
.btn:hover::after{transform:translateX(120%)}
.btn-g{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);color:#fff;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}.btn-g:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);transform:translateY(-3px)}
@keyframes gr{to{background-position:200% 0}}
/* nav */
header{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;z-index:60;transition:.4s}
header.s{background:rgba(10,18,38,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.4);box-shadow:0 10px 30px -15px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:80px;color:#fff}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-decoration:none}
.logo i{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand),var(--gold));display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(245,196,81,.5)}
.logo b{font-family:Cinzel,serif;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.06em;line-height:1.05}.logo small{display:block;font:600 .66rem Inter;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold)}
.links{display:flex;gap:30px;list-style:none;align-items:center}
.links a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;font-size:.95rem;opacity:.9;position:relative}
.links a:not(.btn)::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-6px;height:2px;width:100%;background:var(--gold);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:.3s}
.links a:not(.btn):hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.links .btn{padding:11px 22px}
.burger{display:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:12px;width:46px;height:46px;cursor:pointer}
.burger span{display:block;width:22px;height:2px;background:#fff;margin:5px auto;transition:.3s}
.burger[aria-expanded=true] span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg)}.burger[aria-expanded=true] span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}.burger[aria-expanded=true] span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg)}
/* hero */
.hero{min-height:100vh;min-height:100svh;display:flex;align-items:center;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;padding:130px 0 90px;background:var(--navy);isolation:isolate}
.hero .bg{position:absolute;inset:-8% 0;background:url(data:image/webp;base64,) center/cover;z-index:-3;will-change:transform;filter:saturate(1.1)}
.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 45%,rgba(10,18,38,.55),rgba(10,18,38,.92) 70%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,18,38,.6),rgba(10,18,38,.85))}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;height:140px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,var(--bg));z-index:-1}
#stars{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none}
.orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(70px);opacity:.45;z-index:-1;animation:fl 14s ease-in-out infinite}
.o1{width:420px;height:420px;background:#c0264f;top:10%;left:-120px}.o2{width:360px;height:360px;background:#f5c451;bottom:5%;right:-100px;animation-delay:-6s;opacity:.3}
@keyframes fl{50%{transform:translate(40px,-30px) scale(1.1)}}
.hero-in{text-align:center;max-width:1000px;margin:auto}
.hero .eyebrow{color:var(--gold2)}.hero .eyebrow::after{content:"";width:28px;height:2px;background:currentColor}
.title{position:relative;display:inline-block;margin:6px 0 26px}
.title h1{font-family:Cinzel,serif;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(3rem,10.5vw,8.4rem);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:.02em;
 background:linear-gradient(100deg,#c9922c 0%,#ffe9a8 18%,#fff 25%,#f5c451 32%,#c9922c 45%,#ffe39a 60%,#fff8dc 66%,#e0a83a 75%,#c9922c 100%);background-size:250% 100%;
 -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:shine 5s linear infinite;
 filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 0 rgba(90,55,0,.6)) drop-shadow(0 0 28px rgba(245,196,81,.45)) drop-shadow(0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.7))}
.title h1 span{display:block}
.title .loc{display:block;font-family:Inter;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(.85rem,1.6vw,1.15rem);letter-spacing:.6em;color:#fff;margin-top:14px;text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.8);padding-left:.6em}
@keyframes shine{from{background-position:250% 0}to{background-position:0 0}}
.tw{position:absolute;width:var(--s,18px);height:var(--s,18px);pointer-events:none;animation:twk 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:var(--d,0s)}
.tw::before,.tw::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(#fff 0,#ffe9a8 30%,transparent 70%);clip-path:polygon(50% 0,60% 40%,100% 50%,60% 60%,50% 100%,40% 60%,0 50%,40% 40%)}
.tw::after{filter:blur(4px)}
@keyframes twk{0%,100%{transform:scale(0) rotate(0);opacity:0}50%{transform:scale(1) rotate(90deg);opacity:1}}
.tagline{font-family:Fraunces;font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.2rem);color:#fff;margin-bottom:18px;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.tagline em{color:var(--gold)}
.hero p.sub{font-size:clamp(1rem,1.5vw,1.18rem);max-width:60ch;margin:0 auto 38px;color:#e6e9f0;text-shadow:0 1px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.cta{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
.chips{margin-top:46px;display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip{padding:10px 18px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);font-size:.88rem}
.scroll{position:absolute;bottom:34px;left:50%;translate:-50% 0;width:26px;height:42px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);border-radius:20px}
.scroll::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:8px;width:4px;height:8px;margin-left:-2px;background:#fff;border-radius:2px;animation:sc 1.8s infinite}
@keyframes sc{to{transform:translateY(14px);opacity:0}}
/* about */
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px;align-items:center}
.ph{position:relative;border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/5;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.ph .bgp{position:absolute;inset:-10%;background-size:cover;background-position:center;will-change:transform}
.glass{position:absolute;left:22px;right:22px;bottom:22px;padding:24px 26px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(1.5);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);color:#fff}
.glass p{font-family:Fraunces;font-size:1.3rem;line-height:1.35}
.badge{position:absolute;top:-20px;right:-20px;width:130px;height:130px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,var(--gold),var(--brand),var(--gold));color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.3;animation:rot 12s linear infinite;box-shadow:var(--sh);z-index:2}
.badge span{background:var(--navy);width:112px;height:112px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;animation:rot 12s linear infinite reverse;padding:10px}
@keyframes rot{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.abw{position:relative}
/* services */
.alt{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f4eee4,var(--bg))}
.head{text-align:center;max-width:740px;margin:0 auto 64px}.head .eyebrow::after{content:"";width:28px;height:2px;background:currentColor}.head p{color:var(--ink2);font-size:1.1rem}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px}
.card{position:relative;border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;min-height:430px;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;box-shadow:var(--sh);isolation:isolate}
.card .bgc{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center;z-index:-2;transition:transform 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,18,38,.05) 25%,rgba(10,18,38,.92))}
.card:hover .bgc{transform:scale(1.1)}
.card .ci{padding:28px}
.card h3{font-size:1.5rem;margin-bottom:8px}.card p{font-size:.95rem;color:#dfe4ee}
.card .more{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;margin-top:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gold);transition:gap .3s}.card:hover .more{gap:14px}
.card .n{position:absolute;top:22px;left:22px;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600}
/* journey */
.journey{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.journey::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:url(data:image/webp;base64,) center/cover fixed;opacity:.18}
.journey .head p{color:#c7cfdd}.journey .eyebrow{color:var(--gold)}
.tl{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:18px}
.tl a{position:relative;display:block;padding:30px 24px;border-radius:22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);text-decoration:none;transition:.4s}
.tl a::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-1px;border-radius:inherit;padding:1px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),transparent 40%,var(--brand));-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);-webkit-mask-composite:xor;mask-composite:exclude;opacity:0;transition:.4s}
.tl a:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}.tl a:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tl strong{font-family:Cinzel;font-size:1.8rem;display:block;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold2));-webkit-background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.tl span{font-size:.92rem;color:#dfe4ec}
/* gallery */
.filters{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:36px}
.filters button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:999px;font:600 .9rem Inter;color:var(--ink2);cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}
.filters button:hover{border-color:var(--brand);color:var(--brand)}
.filters button[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
.gal{columns:4 240px;column-gap:14px}
.g{display:block;width:100%;margin:0 0 14px;border:0;padding:0;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;cursor:zoom-in;background:#e9e2d5;break-inside:avoid;position:relative}
.g img{width:100%;height:auto;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),filter .4s}
.g::after{content:"⤢";position:absolute;inset:auto 12px 12px auto;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);color:var(--navy);opacity:0;transform:scale(.6);transition:.3s}
.g:hover img{transform:scale(1.06);filter:brightness(1.05)}.g:hover::after{opacity:1;transform:none}
.g.hide{display:none}
.more-wrap{text-align:center;margin-top:30px}
.gal.clip .g.extra{display:none}
.lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(5,9,20,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:60px 70px}
.lb.open{display:flex;animation:fi .3s}
@keyframes fi{from{opacity:0}}
.lb img{max-width:100%;max-height:82vh;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.lb button{position:absolute;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);color:#fff;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;font-size:1.4rem;cursor:pointer;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.lb button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.lb .x{top:18px;right:18px}.lb .pv{left:14px;top:50%}.lb .nx{right:14px;top:50%}
.lb .cap{position:absolute;bottom:18px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;color:#cdd3df;font-size:.9rem}
/* help */
.ideas{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:14px}
.ideas li{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:20px 22px;transition:.3s}
.ideas li:hover{transform:translateX(6px);box-shadow:var(--sh);border-color:transparent}
.ideas .k{flex:none;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand),#e8608a);color:#fff;font-weight:700}
.ideas b{display:block;color:var(--ink)}
.vol{margin-top:28px;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;min-height:220px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;color:#fff;isolation:isolate}
.vol .bgc{position:absolute;inset:0;background:url(data:image/webp;base64,) center/cover;z-index:-2}
.vol::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(10,18,38,.9));z-index:-1}
.vol div{padding:24px}.vol a{color:var(--gold)}
/* donate */
.donate{position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;border-radius:36px;padding:100px 56px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--sh);isolation:isolate}
.donate .bgc{position:absolute;inset:-10%;background:url(data:image/webp;base64,) center/cover;z-index:-3;will-change:transform}
.donate::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(150,20,60,.93),rgba(10,18,38,.9) 60%,rgba(120,80,10,.88));background-size:200% 200%;animation:gm 12s ease infinite}
@keyframes gm{50%{background-position:100% 100%}}
.donate h2{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,5.5vw,4.2rem);margin-bottom:18px}
.donate h2 em{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),#fff,var(--gold));background-size:200%;-webkit-background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:gr 4s linear infinite}
.donate>p{max-width:58ch;margin:0 auto 38px;font-size:1.15rem;color:#f1e9ee}
.amts{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:30px}
.amts a{min-width:100px;padding:16px 22px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);font-weight:700;font-size:1.2rem;text-decoration:none;transition:.25s}
.amts a:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--brand);transform:translateY(-4px)}
.btn-w{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f5c451,#ffe9a8,#f5c451);background-size:200%;color:#3b2500;font-size:1.12rem;padding:19px 44px;animation:gr 5s linear infinite;box-shadow:0 18px 40px -12px rgba(245,196,81,.7)}.btn-w:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.02)}
.pay{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:32px}
.pay a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:46px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;font-size:.95rem;gap:6px;transition:.25s}
.pay a:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.secure{margin-top:24px;font-size:.88rem;color:#e7dde3}
/* contact */
.cgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}
.cc{display:block;text-decoration:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.75);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:30px;transition:.35s}
.cc:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--sh);border-color:transparent}
.cc .ic{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:15px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--navy);color:var(--gold);font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:18px;transition:.35s}
.cc:hover .ic{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand),var(--gold));color:#fff;transform:rotate(-8deg)}
.cc h3{font-size:1.2rem;margin-bottom:4px}.cc p{color:var(--ink2);font-size:.94rem;word-break:break-word}
footer{background:var(--navy);color:#bfc8d8;padding:80px 0 34px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
footer::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--brand),var(--gold),var(--brand));background-size:200%;animation:gr 6s linear infinite}
.fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px}
footer h4{color:#fff;margin-bottom:14px}footer ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:8px}footer a{text-decoration:none}footer a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.fbig{font-family:Cinzel;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3vw,2.2rem);background:linear-gradient(100deg,#c9922c,#ffe9a8,#f5c451,#c9922c);background-size:250%;-webkit-background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:shine 6s linear infinite;margin-bottom:10px}
.legal{border-top:1px solid #1e2b45;margin-top:50px;padding-top:24px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;font-size:.88rem}
/* reveal */
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px);transition:opacity 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);transition-delay:var(--dl,0s)}.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.rv-l{transform:translateX(-50px)}.rv-r{transform:translateX(50px)}.rv-s{transform:scale(.92)}
@media (max-width:1000px){.cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.tl{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.cgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media (max-width:860px){
 section{padding:84px 0}.split{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:48px}.fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .burger{display:block}
 .links{position:fixed;inset:80px 12px auto 12px;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:2px;padding:18px;border-radius:22px;background:rgba(10,18,38,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(-14px);transition:.3s}
 .links.open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:none}
 .links a{display:block;padding:13px 10px;font-size:1.08rem}.links a::after{display:none}.links .btn{justify-content:center;margin-top:8px}
 .donate{padding:64px 22px;border-radius:26px}.badge{width:104px;height:104px;right:-6px;top:-16px;font-size:.68rem}.badge span{width:90px;height:90px}
 .lb{padding:60px 10px}.lb .pv,.lb .nx{top:auto;bottom:14px}.lb .cap{bottom:80px}
 .journey::before{background-attachment:scroll}
}
